text:
claire.marketing: Hey team — draft for the product launch blog is ready for a final pass. I pasted the doc and asset links below. Need approvals by EOD Wed so we can hit the publish window Thu 09:00 PT. Key asks: quick final copy check, hero image signoff, UTM/tracking + HubSpot form ID, legal quick pass, and confirm CTA copy. Doc: https://docs.google.com/.../product-launch-draft (comments enabled)

devon.content: reading now — will push a few small copy nits (tighten intro, reframe 'scale' → 'throughput') and remove one line that sounds like a direct competitor claim. ETA 30m.

maria.design: just uploaded hero comps to Figma — link: https://figma.com/file/.../product-launch-hero. PNG export (1200x628) is at /assets/blog/product-launch-hero.png. I also added a smaller thumbnail for socials.

arjun.growth: UTM recs: campaign=product_launch_q2_2026, source=blog, medium=referral. For content-level tracking use utm_content=benchmark_narrative or =webinar_cta depending on which module we push. Also recommend A/B test CTA copy: "Try Redwood Free" vs "See Latency Benchmarks". Thoughts?

nate.analytics: HubSpot form ID for the launch capture is 3f2a7b. I'll wire the HS form to the landing event and create the GA4 goal. Example tracking URL (use exact formatting):

https://redwood.com/blog/dedicated-inference?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=product_launch_q2_2026&utm_content=benchmark_narrative

(Please paste this exact string into the CTA/button href.)

lila.legal: Quick pass complete. Flagged one comparative sentence — removed it and added a neutral reword. No legal blockers.

devon.content: I removed the claim and tightened the intro. Also added a short testimonial pull-quote near the top. Ready for final read.

claire.marketing: Good. Scheduling note: target publish Thu 09:00 PT. @publish-bot, can you schedule the post and the cross-post to LinkedIn and Twitter? Also confirm the canonical URL and sitemap ping.

maria.design: :thumbsup: Hero and socials good from design.

nate.analytics: :thumbsup: tracking and form wired. I'll validate events after publish.

publish-bot: publish scheduled for 2026-03-12T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Cross-posts queued for 09:05 PT. Canonical URL set to https://redwood.com/blog/dedicated-inference. Sitemap ping scheduled.

arjun.growth: I'll build the webinar nurture flow and map lead routing to the "Product Launch 2026" campaign in HubSpot. Plan: immediate thank-you email, 3-touch nurture, and an SDR alert for MQLs. @devon please add the webinar CTA block in the post body (inline + bottom of post).

devon.content: Added the webinar CTA with registration link and short copy. Also inserted the testimonial. One open question — headline variant A or B? I can push both to the CMS for the A/B if we want.

claire.marketing: Let's go A/B test the headline. Deploy variant A as default and run for 48h, then evaluate CTRs. Final checklist: hero ✅, copy ✅, UTM ✅, legal ✅, hubspot form ✅, webinar CTA ✅, scheduling ✅. Any objections to going live on the scheduled time?

lila.legal: No objections.

maria.design: No objections.

nate.analytics: No objections.

claire.marketing: Awesome. Post-publish action items: Nate to collect first-week metrics (impressions, CTR, form submits, webinar signups), Arjun to report MQLs to sales, Devon to monitor comments/feedback. I'll run a quick post-mortem next Friday. Thanks everyone — see you on the other side of launch! :rocket:
